note: Règles écrites par nous à partir des pages medicare.gov/coverage lues le 2026-10-24 (œuvres du gouvernement fédéral, 17 U.S.C. § 105). Chaque règle cite sa page.

hearing-aids.rule: Original Medicare pays for neither hearing aids nor the exams to fit them; you pay all costs. Some Medicare Advantage plans add a hearing benefit.

hearing-exam.rule: Diagnostic hearing and balance exams ordered by a provider: 20% after the Part B deductible, plus a hospital copayment in a hospital outpatient department. Once every 12 months you may see an audiologist without an order for gradual hearing loss.

dental.rule: Routine cleanings, fillings, extractions, dentures and implants are not covered. Exceptions: dental care tied to a covered treatment (before a heart valve replacement or transplant, before cancer treatment, for dialysis patients) or during a hospital stay.

cataract-surgery.rule: Surgery with a conventional intraocular lens: 20% of the approved amount to both the facility and the surgeon after the Part B deductible. Premium lenses cost extra.

eyeglasses.rule: Glasses and contact lenses are not covered, except one pair of glasses with standard frames (or one set of contacts) after each cataract surgery with a lens implant: 20% after the deductible, from a supplier enrolled in Medicare. Upgraded frames cost extra.

ambulance.rule: Ground ambulance when any other vehicle could endanger your health, to the nearest appropriate facility: 20% after the Part B deductible. Non-emergency trips need a written order and may need prior authorization after repeated trips.

home-health.rule: Covered home health services cost nothing; medical equipment the agency supplies costs 20% after the Part B deductible. Part-time or intermittent care, generally up to 8 hours a day and 28 hours a week.

physical-therapy.rule: Medically necessary outpatient physical therapy certified by your provider: 20% after the Part B deductible, with no yearly dollar limit (above the 2026 KX threshold of $2,480 the therapist must document medical necessity).

chiropractic.rule: Only manual spinal adjustments to correct a subluxation: 20% after the Part B deductible. X-rays, massage and other services a chiropractor orders are not covered.

colonoscopy.rule: Screening colonoscopy: $0 if the provider accepts assignment; once every 120 months at average risk, 24 months at high risk. If a polyp is removed you pay 15% (2026) of the approved amount to the doctor and the facility, with no deductible; 10% from 2027 to 2029. A colonoscopy for symptoms is diagnostic: 20% after the deductible.

shingles-vaccine.rule: Covered by Part D drug plans at no cost: no deductible and no copayment for vaccines recommended by ACIP. Without Part D, Original Medicare does not pay for it.

cpap.rule: 12-week trial for diagnosed obstructive sleep apnea, then continued coverage if your provider documents that it helps. Machine rented for 13 continuous months, then it is yours; 20% of the rental and supplies after the Part B deductible.

wheelchairs.rule: Manual and power wheelchairs and scooters when medically necessary for use in the home; power chairs and scooters need a face-to-face exam and written order, some power chairs need prior authorization. 20% after the Part B deductible.

knee-replacement.rule: As an inpatient: the Part A deductible per benefit period, plus 20% of the surgeon's fee under Part B. As a hospital outpatient: 20% of the surgeon's fee and the hospital copayment, which cannot exceed the Part A deductible for one service.

mri.rule: Diagnostic MRI ordered by a provider: 20% after the Part B deductible at an accredited office or imaging center; at a hospital outpatient department a copayment that usually cannot exceed the Part A deductible.

dialysis.rule: Outpatient dialysis at a facility: 20% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible, usually 3 treatments a week. Inpatient dialysis falls under Part A.

snf.rule: After a qualifying hospital stay: days 1-20 $0 (after the Part A deductible, unless already paid in the same benefit period), days 21-100 $217 a day in 2026, day 101 on all costs.

hospital.rule: Each benefit period in 2026: the $1,736 deductible covers days 1-60, $434 a day for days 61-90, $868 a day for days 91-150 while using the 60 lifetime reserve days, all costs after that.

hospice.rule: Nothing for hospice care from a Medicare-approved provider, except up to $5 per outpatient prescription for symptom control and 5% of the approved amount for inpatient respite care; room and board in a nursing home is not covered.

covid-test.rule: A COVID-19 lab test ordered by your provider usually costs nothing at a laboratory, pharmacy, clinic or hospital that takes Medicare.

acupuncture.rule: Only for chronic low back pain (12 weeks or more, no known cause): up to 12 sessions in 90 days, 8 more if you improve, 20 a year at most; 20% after the deductible. Licensed acupuncturists cannot bill Medicare directly.

mammogram.rule: Screening mammogram once every 12 months from age 40: $0 if the provider accepts assignment. Diagnostic mammogram: 20% after the deductible.

eye-exam-routine.rule: Routine eye exams (refractions) for glasses or contact lenses are not covered; you pay all costs.

eye-exam-medical.rule: A yearly diabetic retinopathy exam for people with diabetes, glaucoma tests for people at high risk, and exams to diagnose or treat an eye disease: 20% after the deductible, plus a hospital copayment in an outpatient department.

podiatry.rule: Medically necessary foot exams and treatment (injuries, hammer toe, bunions, heel spurs): 20% after the deductible. Routine foot care such as nail trimming is covered only in limited circumstances.

office-visit.rule: Doctor services: 20% of the approved amount after the Part B deductible; a doctor who does not accept assignment can charge up to 15% more than the non-participating approved amount.

wellness-visit.rule: Yearly wellness visit: $0 if the provider accepts assignment; other tests done the same day may cost 20%.

er-visit.rule: A hospital copayment for the visit and for each hospital service, plus 20% of the doctor's fee after the Part B deductible; no copayment if you are admitted to the same hospital for a related condition within 3 days.
